title: Replay an already-admitted task-sync rebuild basis import
outcome: A clean repeat of the same explicit saved-basis import converges after a successful own-rebuild adoption, a lost receipt or a journal-cleanup failure. Later local work remains owed and an unrelated basis or changed committed tip still uses ordinary admission.
acceptance: A behavioral test commits an own rebuild, edits a task locally, imports the saved basis, then repeats the same import without a false divergence or duplicate planning changes.

A deterministic post-commit journal-cleanup failure or lost receipt can be retried to the same successful state, with the matching slot retired and the later local edit available to ordinary incremental export.
A changed tip or unrelated saved envelope cannot replay that success.
